summary_en: This study tests A2B395, an allogeneic logic-gated CAR T-cell product, in adults with solid tumors that express EGFR and have lost HLA-A*02, including colorectal, lung, head and neck, breast, and kidney cancers. Participants receive a preconditioning lymphodepletion regimen, then a single intravenous dose of A2B395 on day 0. The Phase 1 main question is the recommended dose that is safe for patients, and the Phase 2 main question is whether that dose kills solid tumor cells and protects healthy cells.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa A2B395, un producto de células CAR T alogénicas de compuerta lógica, en adultos con tumores sólidos que expresan EGFR y han perdido HLA-A*02, incluidos cáncer colorrectal, de pulmón, de cabeza y cuello, de mama y de riñón. Los participantes reciben un régimen de preacondicionamiento con linfodepleción y luego una sola dosis intravenosa de A2B395 el día 0. La pregunta principal de la Fase 1 es la dosis recomendada que es segura para los pacientes, y la de la Fase 2 es si esa dosis destruye las células tumorales y protege las células sanas.
who_for: Enrolled in the BASECAMP-1 study, with tumor tissue showing HLA-A*02 loss by NGS.
Recurrent, unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic CRC, NSCLC, HNSCC, TNBC, RCC, or other EGFR-expressing solid tumors.
Measurable disease, with lesions of at least 1.0 cm by CT.
ECOG performance status of 0 to 1 and life expectancy of at least 3 months.
Willing to follow the study schedule, including long-term safety follow-up.
not_for: Disease suitable for local therapy or standard therapy that is therapeutic and not palliative.
Prior allogeneic stem cell transplant or prior solid organ transplant.
Cancer therapy within 3 weeks, or radiotherapy within 28 days, of A2B395 infusion.
Significant cardiac disease within 6 months, or new symptomatic PE or DVT within 3 months.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or of childbearing potential and not willing to use birth control through 6 months after infusion.
cancer_types: head and neck squamous cell carcinoma
